name: Norwood Shopping Center
summary: Norwood Shopping Center is a neighborhood retail destination on Walpole Street in Norwood, MA, serving the southern Boston suburbs with convenient daily shopping options. With a 4.3-star rating and consistent 9 AM to 9 PM hours, it provides reliable access to everyday goods and services for local residents.
demographics: Norwood Shopping Center serves a diverse suburban Boston demographic, primarily attracting middle-income families and working professionals from Norwood and surrounding communities like Dedham, Canton, and Westwood. The trade area consists largely of homeowners aged 35-65 with household incomes ranging from $75,000 to $125,000, reflecting the stable residential character of this Route 1 corridor community. Shoppers typically visit for convenience-oriented needs and everyday services, with strong weekday traffic from local residents and commuters along the busy Walpole Street commercial strip.
description: Norwood Shopping Center is a well-established neighborhood retail destination located at 444 Walpole Street in Norwood, Massachusetts, serving the southern suburban Boston market. Strategically positioned along one of Norwood's primary commercial corridors, this shopping center has been a reliable fixture for local residents seeking convenient access to everyday goods and services. The center maintains a solid reputation within the community, reflected in its 4.3-star rating from over 300 Google reviews, indicating consistent customer satisfaction. Operating daily from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM, the shopping center provides accessible hours that accommodate both working professionals and families throughout the week. As a neighborhood-oriented retail hub in this densely populated suburban area, Norwood Shopping Center continues to serve as a practical shopping destination for the local community's daily needs.
